⚠ 'HE'S GOT' = 'HE HAS GOT'

     He's got a beard.

  ular fe'l/sifat bilan BIRGA yodlanadi.

  ⚠ Hamma ibora 7-betdagi matnda bor edi.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to have sth IN common
     = umumiy narsaga ega bo'lmoq
     'We have a lot in common.'

  to be proud OF sb/sth
     = ... dan faxrlanmoq
     'I am proud of my son.'

  to live IN a village

     ⚠ 'in a village', 'in a city',
     lekin 'ON a farm', 'AT home'

  to consist OF sth
     = ... dan iborat bo'lmoq

     shaklda ishlatilmaydi.

  to be well known FOR sth
     = ... bilan mashhur bo'lmoq
     ⚠ 'for' PREDLOG, shuning uchun
     keyin -ING: 'well known for BEING
     generous'.


⚠ 'FOR' va 'AS' FARQI:

  well known FOR sth = nimasi bilan
     mashhur (sabab)
  known AS sth = qanday nom bilan
     tanilgan

  'He is well known FOR his songs.'
  'He is known AS the King of Pop.'

  Peter - keksa erkak, kalta oq

  Mike  - yosh erkak, kalta qora

  Sara  - keksa ayol, kalta jingalak

    tabassum, to'q yuz

  fair complexion = oq yuz
  dark complexion = to'q (qoramtir)
  yuz.


⚠ 'WRINKLES':

  = ajinlar (keksalarda).


⚠ 'GLASSES' - KO'PLIK:

  'He wears glasses' / 'He has got
  glasses'. ⚠ 'a glasses' - XATO.

tasks.en: Hello, People of Thailand!
tasks.uz: Salom, Tailand xalqi!

tasks.en: Whatever country we come from, whatever colour our skin is, we all have one thing in common: we are all people of the world.
tasks.uz: Qaysi mamlakatdan bo'lsak ham, terimizning rangi qanday bo'lsa ham, bizda bitta umumiy narsa bor: hammamiz dunyo odamlarimiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'whatever' = qanday bo'lmasin, har qanday.

⚠ 'to have sth in common' = umumiy narsaga
ega bo'lmoq. Turg'un ibora.

⚠ 'colour' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh: 'color').

tasks.en: Thailand is a beautiful country with a rich culture, just south of China.
tasks.uz: Tailand - boy madaniyatga ega go'zal mamlakat, Xitoydan janubda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'south of China' = Xitoydan janubda.
Predlog 'of' bilan.

⚠ 'rich' bu yerda 'boy' (pul emas, madaniyat).

tasks.en: People call it 'the jewel of south-east Asia' for a good reason.
tasks.uz: Odamlar uni bejiz 'janubi-sharqiy Osiyoning javohiri' deb atamaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a jewel' = javohir, qimmatbaho tosh.
⚠ 'for a good reason' = bejiz emas, asosli sabab bilan.

⚠ 'to call sth sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi:
'call IT the jewel'.

tasks.en: Its tropical climate, white sandy beaches and ancient temples make it a perfect holiday destination.
tasks.uz: Tropik iqlimi, oq qumli plyajlari va qadimiy ibodatxonalari uni mukammal ta'til manziliga aylantiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'ITS' (apostrofsiz) = uning (egalik).
'IT'S' (apostrof bilan) = 'it is'.
Bu - eng ko'p xato qilinadigan juftlik.

⚠ 'a destination' = manzil, borish joyi.
⚠ 'ancient' = qadimiy.

tasks.en: What makes it really special, though, is its people.
tasks.uz: Uni haqiqatan ham alohida qiladigan narsa esa - uning xalqi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = 'lekin, esa'.
Verguller bilan ajratiladi.

⚠ 'What makes it special IS ...' - bu
'cleft sentence': fikrni ta'kidlash qolipi.

tasks.en: Thai people are good-looking. They are short with delicate features.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar chiroyli. Ular past bo'yli, nozik yuz tuzilishiga ega.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'good-looking' = chiroyli (erkak va ayol uchun
ham). DEFIS bilan yoziladi.

⚠ 'delicate' = nozik, mayin.
⚠ 'features' = yuz tuzilishi (ko'z, burun, og'iz).

tasks.en: They have got black hair, dark eyes and light brown skin.
tasks.uz: Ularning sochi qora, ko'zlari to'q rangli, terisi och jigarrang.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'have got' - Britaniya egaligi.
⚠ 'hair' va 'skin' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar.

⚠ 'light brown' = och jigarrang;
'dark brown' = to'q jigarrang.

tasks.en: The Thais are friendly people who are well known for being generous and kind.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar - saxovatli va mehribonligi bilan mashhur samimiy xalq.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'THE Thais' - millat nomi oldidan 'the'.
⚠ 'well known FOR' + -ING shakli.

⚠ 'generous' = saxovatli; 'kind' = mehribon.

tasks.en: "We are a happy people who have strong wills and are especially proud of our history," says Kasem from Bangkok.
tasks.uz: "Biz kuchli irodali va tariximizdan alohida faxrlanadigan baxtli xalqmiz", - deydi Bangkoklik Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a people' (artikl bilan) = XALQ, millat.
'people' (artiklsiz) = odamlar.

⚠ 'a will' = iroda.
⚠ 'proud OF' - predlog 'of'.

tasks.en: Most people in Thailand live in villages.
tasks.uz: Tailand aholisining ko'pi qishloqlarda yashaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'most people' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'THE most' faqat qiyoslashda: 'the most
beautiful'.

tasks.en: A typical Thai village consists of wooden houses, a school and a Buddhist temple.
tasks.uz: Odatiy tailand qishlog'i yog'och uylar, maktab va buddaviylik ibodatxonasidan iborat.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to consist OF' - predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ 'wooden' = yog'ochdan ('wood' + -EN).
⚠ 'Buddhist' - katta harf bilan (din nomi).

tasks.en: The men usually work in the fields or catch fish in the rivers, and the women plant the crops.
tasks.uz: Erkaklar odatda dalada ishlaydi yoki daryolarda baliq ovlaydi, ayollar esa ekin ekadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat, doimiy ish.
⚠ 'usually' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

tasks.en: Family life is very important in Thailand, and families often eat together.
tasks.uz: Tailandda oila hayoti juda muhim va oilalar ko'pincha birga ovqatlanadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'often' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN: 'often EAT'.

⚠ 7-mashqning 4-gapida aynan shu jumla
inkor qilingan edi → javob F.

tasks.en: Thai food is very spicy and includes curries, fish, seafood, soups and noodles.
tasks.uz: Tailand taomi juda o'tkir bo'lib, karri, baliq, dengiz mahsulotlari, sho'rvalar va ugrani o'z ichiga oladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'spicy' = o'tkir, ziravorli ('a spice' = ziravor).
⚠ 'noodles' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.

tasks.en: "We eat rice with our meals and use a lot of strong spices in our cooking," explains Kasem.
tasks.uz: "Biz ovqatimiz bilan guruch yeymiz va pishirishda ko'p o'tkir ziravor ishlatamiz", - tushuntiradi Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish mahali (nonushta,
tushlik, kechki ovqat).
⚠ 'a lot of' - sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.

tasks.en: Thai people love to enjoy themselves. Popular free-time activities include Thai boxing and watching traditional dance shows.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar ko'ngil ochishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ommabop bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari - tailand boksi va an'anaviy raqs tomoshalarini ko'rish.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to enjoy ONESELF' = ko'ngil ochmoq.
O'zlik olmoshi ShART.

⚠ 'free-time' - defis bilan, chunki sifat
vazifasida.

tasks.en: Thais also celebrate many festivals throughout the year.
tasks.uz: Tailandliklar yil davomida ko'plab bayramlarni ham nishonlaydi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'throughout the year' = yil davomida.
⚠ 'to celebrate' = nishonlamoq.

tasks.en: "My favourite holiday is Surin, in November, when we always have elephant football matches," says Kasem.
tasks.uz: "Sevimli bayramim - noyabrdagi Surin, unda biz doim fil futboli musobaqalarini o'tkazamiz", - deydi Kasem.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'favourite' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh:
'favorite').
⚠ 'in November' - oy oldidan 'in'.

⚠ K suratidagi fil futboli aynan shu.

tasks.en: Thailand is a wonderful country. Its fascinating sights, rich cultural history and warm-hearted people make it unique.
tasks.uz: Tailand - ajoyib mamlakat. Uning maftunkor manzaralari, boy madaniy tarixi va ochiqko'ngil odamlari uni betakror qiladi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'fascinating' = maftunkor.
⚠ 'a sight' = ko'rgazmali joy, manzara.
⚠ 'warm-hearted' = ochiqko'ngil (warm + heart).
⚠ 'unique' = betakror, yagona.

  Present simple (odat/fakt):

  Continuous (KELAJAK rejasi):

exercises.instructionEn: Present Simple and Present Continuous - form and use.
exercises.instructionUz: Present Simple va Present Continuous - shakli va qo'llanishi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HOZIRGI ZAMON.


=== PRESENT SIMPLE ===

ShAKLI:
  I / you / we / they  + FE'L
  he / she / it        + FE'L + S

  I work.      He workS.
  We live.     She liveS.

INKOR:
  I don't work.   He doesn't work.
  ⚠ 'doesn't' dan keyin -S TUShADI!
  'He doesn't workS' - XATO.

SO'ROQ:
  Do you work?   Does he work?

⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDAGI -S QOIDALARI:
  work  → works
  go    → goes   (o, s, sh, ch, x dan
  watch → watches   keyin -ES)
  study → studies (undosh + y → -IES)
  play  → plays   (unli + y → faqat -S)
  have  → has     (istisno)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  a) odat, kundalik ish
     'We spend our days hiking.'
  b) doimiy holat
     'Norwegians love the outdoors.'
  c) umumiy haqiqat
     'The sun rises in the east.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  always, usually, often, sometimes,
  never, every day, on Mondays


=== PRESENT CONTINUOUS ===

ShAKLI:
  am / is / are + FE'L + ING

  I am working.
  He is working.
  We are working.

INKOR:
  I'm not working.
  He isn't working.

SO'ROQ:
  Are you working?
  Is he working?

⚠ -ING QO'ShISh QOIDALARI:
  work  → working
  make  → making   (oxirgi 'e' TUShADI)
  sit   → sitting  (qisqa unli + bitta
                    undosh → UNDOSh
                    IKKILANADI)
  lie   → lying    (-ie → -ying)

QAChON IShLATILADI:
  c) aynan hozir bo'layotgan ish
     'At the moment we are having a
      cup of hot chocolate.'
  e) shu davrda bo'layotgan ish
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
  d) yaqin kelajakdagi ANIQ reja
     'Next week we're going to Oslo.'

BELGI SO'ZLARI:
  now, at the moment, right now,
  today, this week, look!, listen!


=== ENG MUHIM FARQ ===

  'I work in a bank.'
     = mening kasbim shu (DOIMIY)

  'I'm working in a bank.'
     = hozircha shu yerda ishlayapman
       (VAQTINChA)


=== HOLAT FE'LLARI (state verbs) ===

  Bu fe'llar CONTINUOUS shaklda
  IShLATILMAYDI:

  like, love, hate, want, need,
  know, understand, believe,
  remember, forget, mean,
  belong, own, cost, seem

  ⚠ 'I am loving' - XATO.
     'I love' - to'g'ri.

  ⚠ Betdagi 26-mashqda: 'Mr Harris
  NEEDS me' - 'is needing' EMAS.


⚠ 'HAVE' - IKKI XIL:

  EGALIK ma'nosida - continuous YO'Q:
     'I have a car.' ('I am having a
      car' - XATO)

  IBORALARDA - continuous BOR:
     'We are having a cup of hot
      chocolate.'
     'I'm having a fantastic time.'
     'We are having a meeting.'

  ⚠ Xatda ikkalasi ham uchraydi!

  U Britaniyada Royal Theatre Company
  bilan ishlaydi.


⚠ QAYSI YoRDAMChI QAChON:

  AM / IS / ARE ishlatiladi:
     a) 'to be' fe'li o'zi
        'I AM an actress.'
     b) PRESENT CONTINUOUS uchun
        'I AM working.'

  DO / DOES ishlatiladi:
     PRESENT SIMPLE ning so'roq va
     inkor shakli uchun
        'What DO you do?'
        'The sun DOES not shine.'

  ⚠ 'do' - I/you/we/they bilan
  ⚠ 'does' - he/she/it bilan


⚠ ENG QIYIN JOY - 11 va 12-BANDLAR:

  '11) not like the food'
     ega 'I' → DO
  'the sun 12) not shine'
     ega 'the sun' (= it) → DOES

  ⚠ Ikki qatorda ketma-ket kelgan,
  ataylab: ega o'zgarsa yordamchi ham
  o'zgaradi.


⚠ 10-BAND - 'ISN'T':

  'London 10) like Lisbon at all!'
  = London Lissabonga umuman
    o'xshamaydi.

  ⚠ 'like' bu yerda FE'L emas, PREDLOG
  ('... kabi'). Shuning uchun 'doesn't'
  emas, 'ISN'T'.

  ⚠ 'not ... at all' = umuman emas.


⚠ 19-BAND:

  'Next year we 19) travelling to
   Canada.'
  → ARE (present continuous, kelasi
    zamon ma'nosida)

  ⚠ 'Next year' bo'lsa ham fe'l HOZIRGI
  zamonda - bu 21-mashqning 'd'
  qo'llanishi.


⚠ 'AN ACTRESS':

  an actor  - erkak aktyor
  an actress - ayol aktrisa

  ⚠ Hozirgi ingliz tilida 'actor' ikkala
  jins uchun ham ishlatilmoqda.


⚠ 'TO TOUR':

  = gastrol qilmoq, sayohat qilmoq.
  'we are touring Britain' = Britaniya
  bo'ylab gastrolda yurgan.

exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va ortiqcha so'zni aylantiring. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ShASh TOVUShLAR (similar sounds).

  ⚠ Har qatorda uchta so'z: IKKITASI
  bir xil o'qiladi, BITTASI boshqacha.

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar 'homophones' deb ataladi:
  imlosi boshqa, talaffuzi bir xil.


TO'LIQ TAHLIL:

  1  where /weə/ · wear /weə/ ·
     we're /wɪə/
     → ortiqcha: WE'RE
     ⚠ "we're" = 'we are'

  2  she /ʃiː/ · sea /siː/ · see /siː/
     → ortiqcha: SHE
     ⚠ 'sh' va 's' - boshqa tovush

  3  hair /heə/ · hear /hɪə/ · here /hɪə/
     → ortiqcha: HAIR
     ⚠ 'hear' (eshitmoq) va 'here' (bu
     yerda) bir xil o'qiladi

  4  know /nəʊ/ · no /nəʊ/ · now /naʊ/
     → ortiqcha: NOW
     ⚠ 'know' da 'k' O'QILMAYDI

  5  been /biːn/ · bin /bɪn/ · bean /biːn/
     → ortiqcha: BIN
     ⚠ /iː/ uzun, /ɪ/ qisqa

  6  dear /dɪə/ · deer /dɪə/ · dare /deə/
     → ortiqcha: DARE
     ⚠ 'dear' (aziz) va 'deer' (kiyik)
     bir xil


⚠ IKKI QIYIN JUFTLIK:

  /ɪə/ (i-e): here, hear, dear, deer,
              we're
  /eə/ (e-e): hair, where, wear, dare

  ⚠ O'zbek qulog'iga ikkalasi ham
  'ie' bo'lib eshitiladi - shuning
  uchun ataylab qarshi qo'yilgan.


⚠ /iː/ va /ɪ/ - UZUN VA QISQA:

  been, bean /iː/ - UZUN
  bin /ɪ/ - QISQA

  ⚠ Yana: sheep/ship, seat/sit,
  feel/fill, leave/live.
  ⚠ Bu farq MA'NONI o'zgartiradi!

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ where /weə/ va wear /weə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ we're /wɪə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ "we're" = 'we are' qisqartmasi.

⚠ sea /siː/ va see /siː/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ she /ʃiː/ - 'sh' tovushi bilan.

⚠ 'sea' (dengiz) va 'see' (ko'rmoq) -
homofonlar.

⚠ hear /hɪə/ va here /hɪə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ hair /heə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'hear' (eshitmoq) va 'here' (bu yerda) -
homofonlar.

⚠ know /nəʊ/ va no /nəʊ/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ now /naʊ/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'know' da 'k' O'QILMAYDI - bu 2-unitning
talaffuz mavzusi ('silent letters').

⚠ been /biːn/ va bean /biːn/ - BIR XIL (uzun).
⚠ bin /bɪn/ - QISQA unli.

⚠ 'a bin' = axlat qutisi; 'a bean' = loviya.

⚠ dear /dɪə/ va deer /dɪə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ dare /deə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'dear' (aziz) - xat boshida: 'Dear Mum'.
⚠ 'a deer' = kiyik (ko'plikda ham 'deer').

exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z OILANGIZ HAQIDA GAPIRISh.

  ⚠ Bu betdagi HAMMA so'z shu yerda
  ishlatiladi: 12-mashq jadvali (tashqi
  qiyofa) va 14-mashq sifatlari (xarakter).


⚠ UChTA SAVOL - UChTA BOShQA JAVOB:

  'How many people are there in your
   family?'
     → 'There are five people in my family.'

  'What does he look like?'  (TAShQI)
     → 'He is tall and well-built with
        short dark hair.'

  'What is he like?'  (XARAKTER)
     → 'He is kind and very generous.'

  ⚠ Ikkinchi va uchinchi savolni
  ADAShTIRMANG - bu eng ko'p qilinadigan
  xato.


⚠ 'THERE ARE ... PEOPLE':

  'people' - KO'PLIK ot, shuning uchun
  'there ARE' ('there is' EMAS).

  ⚠ 'How many' + KO'PLIK ot.
  ⚠ 'How much' + sanalmaydigan ot.


⚠ OILA A'ZOLARI:

  parents   - ota-ona
  a father  - ota
  a mother  - ona
  a brother - aka/uka
  a sister  - opa/singil
  a son     - o'g'il
  a daughter- qiz
  grandparents - buvi-bobo

  ⚠ Inglizchada aka va uka BIR XIL
  ('a brother'). Farqlash uchun:
  'my older brother' / 'my younger
  brother'.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG, IKKI VAZIYaT.

  ⚠ Javobni MATNDAN ham topish mumkin -
  audio faqat tekshirish uchun.


1-DIALOG (to'liq matni):

  A: Hi, John! Come on in! Oh, by the
     way, this is Carol. Carol, do you
     know John?
  C: No. Nice to meet you, John.
  J: Hello, Carol. Nice to meet you, too.

  ⚠ 'Come on in!' - uyga taklif.
  ⚠ Demak bu - BAZM (party).


2-DIALOG (to'liq matni):

  S: Hello there! I'm Susan Lloyd. You
     must be Don Brown. Welcome to
     St Mary's!
  D: Thanks. Um, I'm sorry, I didn't
     catch your name.
  S: Susan, Susan Lloyd.
  D: Hi, Susan. I'm glad to meet you.

  ⚠ "St Mary's" - MAKTAB nomi.
  ⚠ Demak bu - yangi O'QITUVChINI
  kutib olish.


⚠ RASMIY VA NORASMIY FARQI:

  NORASMIY (1-dialog):
     Hi! · Come on in! · by the way

  RASMIYROQ (2-dialog):
     Hello there! · Welcome to ...
     I'm glad to meet you.


⚠ 'YOU MUST BE ...':

  = siz ... bo'lsangiz kerak.
  ⚠ 'must' bu yerda MAJBURIYaT emas,
  TAXMIN bildiradi (aniqlik).

  ⚠ Bu - 24-25-betdagi hikoyaning
  grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ "I DIDN'T CATCH YOUR NAME":

  = ismingizni eshitolmadim.
  ⚠ 'to catch' bu yerda 'eshitib
  ulgurmoq' ma'nosida.
  ⚠ Juda muloyim ibora - 'What?' deb
  so'rashdan ancha odobli.


⚠ 'BY THE WAY':

  = aytgancha, darvoqe.
  ⚠ Mavzuni o'zgartirishda ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: BTW (yozishmalarda).

KUTIB OLISh IBORALARI - YoDLASh UChUN.


TANIShTIRISh:
  This is [ism].
  Do you know [ism]?
  I'd like you to meet [ism]. (rasmiy)

  Nice to meet you.
  Nice to meet you, too.

  Pleased to meet you. (rasmiyroq)
  How do you do? (juda rasmiy)

  Come on in!

exercises.instructionEn: Use the sentences to complete the dialogue: Really? Where in Spain? / Julio? How do you spell that? / Yes, it is. / Yes, I do. It's lovely.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplar bilan dialogni to'ldiring: Really? Where in Spain? / Julio? How do you spell that? / Yes, it is. / Yes, I do. It's lovely.
exercises.explanationUz:
TANIShUV DIALOGI (coursebook
  11-bet 29-30-mashqlar).

  ⚠ Har javob OLDINGI savolga mos
  kelishi kerak:

  'Is this your first day?' →
    'Yes, it IS.' (is → is)
  'My name's Julio.' →
    'Julio? How do you SPELL that?'
    → 'J-U-L-I-O'
  'I'm from Spain.' →
    'Really? WHERE in Spain?' →
    'Barcelona'
  'DO you like it here?' →
    'Yes, I DO. It's lovely.'


⚠ 'HOW DO YOU SPELL THAT?':

  = Buni qanday yoziladi (harflab)?
  'to spell' = harflab aytmoq.


⚠ 'REALLY?':

  = Rostdanmi? - qiziqish bildirish.


⚠ 'LOVELY':

  = ajoyib, yoqimli (Brit.).


⚠ QISQA JAVOBLAR:

  Is ...? → Yes, it is.
  Do ...? → Yes, I do.
  ⚠ Savoldagi yordamchi fe'l
  javobda takrorlanadi.

O'YINDA.

  PREDLOG, shuning uchun keyin -ING
  keladi, oddiy fe'l emas.

exercises.instructionUz: Tasavvur qiling, siz dam olish maskanidasiz. Qalamkash do'stingizga joyning joylashuvi, turar joyingiz, ob-havo, manzaralar, mashg'ulotlaringiz, u yerdagi odamlar, ovqat va rejalaringiz haqida xat yozing. Xatni do'stingizga shu joyni tavsiya qilib yakunlang. Yuqoridagi xatni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
NORASMIY XAT - LOYIHA IShI.

  ⚠ Susanning xati AYNAN NAMUNA:
  uning tuzilishini takrorlang.


XATNING SKELETI:

  Dear [ism],

  1) Joylashuv va turar joy
     'I'm so happy to be here in ...
      I'm staying at ...'

  2) Ob-havo, manzaralar, mashg'ulotlar
     'The weather is ...
      The ... are stunning.
      We spend most of our days ...ing.'

  3) Odamlar
     'The people here are very ...
      Most of them tend to be ...'

  4) Ovqat
     'The food is delicious.
      They like eating ..., especially ...'

  5) Rejalar
     'Next week we're going to ...
      I can't wait to ...'

  6) Tavsiya
     'I think you should come here ...
      I'm sure you would love it!'

  See you soon.

  Love,
  [ismingiz]


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  Har xatboshi BITTA mavzuga
  bag'ishlansin. Bu - 17-mashqning
  butun ma'nosi.


⚠ 'A PEN-FRIEND':

  = qalamkash do'st (xat yozib turadigan).
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'pen-friend',
  AQShda 'pen pal'.


⚠ 'A RESORT':

  = dam olish maskani (dengiz bo'yi,
  tog' kurorti).


⚠ NORASMIY XATDA QISQARTMA IShLATING:

  I'm, we're, don't, can't, I'll
  ⚠ Rasmiy xatda esa TO'LIQ shakl.

  ⚠ Susanning xatida hamma joyda
  qisqartma bor - chunki u
  OTA-ONASIGA yozyapti.

sections.title: Writing (an article about a country and its people)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about a country and its people, we can divide our article into six paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola yozganda, maqolani olti xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA YoZISh QOIDASI (kitobdagi quti).


OLTI XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     mamlakat NOMI, JOYLAShUVI va
     XUSUSIYaTLARI

  2-xatboshi:
     odamlar QANDAY KO'RINADI va
     ularning XARAKTERI

  3-xatboshi:
     odamlar QAYERDA yashaydi va
     QANDAY ISh qiladi

  4-xatboshi:
     ular NIMA YEYDI

  5-xatboshi:
     BO'Sh VAQTIDA nima qiladi

  6-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     mamlakat haqida bir necha so'z
     (xulosa)

  ⚠ ZAMON: odatda PRESENT SIMPLE.


⚠ NIMA UChUN PRESENT SIMPLE:

  Maqola DOIMIY holat va ODATLAR
  haqida - o'zgarmaydigan haqiqat.

  'Thai people ARE good-looking.'
  'Most people LIVE in villages.'

  ⚠ Present continuous BO'LMAYDI:
  'Thai people are being good-looking'
  - XATO.


⚠ BU TUZILISh 7-BETDAGI MATNDA
AYNAN BOR:

  Tailand maqolasini qayta o'qing -
  har xatboshi shu rejaga tushadi.

  ⚠ Yaxshi matnni NAMUNA qilib olish -
  yozishni o'rganishning eng tez yo'li.

tasks.en: When we write an article about a country and its people, we can divide our article into six paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola yozganda, maqolani olti xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we include the name of the country, its location and its features.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida mamlakat nomini, joylashuvini va xususiyatlarini yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ 7-betda: 'Thailand is a beautiful country ...
just south of China.'

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we write what the people look like and we describe their character.
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida odamlar qanday ko'rinishini yozamiz va xarakterini tasvirlaymiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'look like' (qiyofa) va 'character' (xislat) -
ikkalasi ham shu xatboshida.

tasks.en: In the third paragraph, we write about where the people live and what work they do.
tasks.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida odamlar qayerda yashashi va qanday ish qilishi haqida yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 7-betda: 'Most people live in villages ...
The men work in the fields.'

tasks.en: In the fourth paragraph, we write about what they eat.
tasks.uz: To'rtinchi xatboshida ular nima yeyishi haqida yozamiz.
tasks.note: ⚠ 7-betda: 'Thai food is very spicy ...'

tasks.en: In the fifth paragraph, we write about what they do in their free time.
tasks.uz: Beshinchi xatboshida ular bo'sh vaqtida nima qilishi haqida yozamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 7-betda: 'Popular free-time activities
include Thai boxing ...'

tasks.en: In the last paragraph we write a few words about the country. We normally use the present simple.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida mamlakat haqida bir necha so'z yozamiz. Odatda present simple ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 7-betda: 'Thailand is a wonderful country ...'

⚠ 'normally' = odatda.
⚠ Maqolada PRESENT SIMPLE - chunki doimiy
haqiqat haqida.

exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va eshitmagan so'zlaringiz ustiga chizing. Nihoyat, qaydlardan foydalanib ispanlar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ISPANLAR HAQIDAGI QAYDLAR.

  ⚠ Har qatorda ortiqcha so'z(lar) bor.
  Qaysi biri ortiqchaligi FAQAT AUDIODA.

  * ⚠ Looks: black hair, brown eyes, not
    very tall - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Character: lively, friendly, sociable,
    lazy - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Dwellings: in cities in small flats,
    bungalows - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Jobs: work in offices, fields, shops,
    factories - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Food: seafood, noodles, omelettes -
    qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Free-time Activities: going to cafes
    and clubs, going out for dinner -
    qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?


⚠ QAYD OLISh USLUBI:

  E'tibor bering: qaydlar TO'LIQ GAP
  emas - faqat kalit so'zlar.

  'black hair, brown eyes, not very tall'
  ('They have got black hair' EMAS)

  ⚠ Gapirganda ulardan to'liq gap
  tuziladi:
  'The Spanish have got black hair and
   brown eyes. They are not very tall.'


⚠ 'THE SPANISH':

  = ispan xalqi.
  ⚠ -sh bilan tugagan millat nomi
  ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI: the Spanish,
  the English, the British, the Irish.
  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA: 'The Spanish ARE ...'


⚠ YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  lively    = jonli, harakatchan
  a bungalow = bir qavatli uy
  a factory = zavod, fabrika
  an omelette = omlet
  to go out for dinner = tashqarida
     ovqatlanmoq

⚠ 'a factory' → ko'plikda 'factorIES'

MAQOLA - LOYIHA IShI.

tasks.en: The Spanish have got black hair and brown eyes, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.

tasks.en: Most Spanish people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.

XAT YAKUNLARI - RASMIY va
  DO'STONA.

DO'STONA XAT - 6 XATBOShI
  (15-mashq qolipi):

  Manzil (o'ng burchak) + sana

  1 Joylashuv/Turar joy

⚠ QAYDLARNI TO'LIQ GAPGA

Brazil

10th January, ...

Dear Carol,

I can't believe I'm here in Rio de Janeiro on holiday! I'm staying with the Serpas. They live in a lovely house in Copacabana near the beach. At the moment, I'm relaxing by the pool.

The weather here is hot and sunny. I spend most of my time exploring the city with the Serpas. We visit Sugarloaf Mountain and walk around the Botanical Gardens.

Brazilians are very friendly and happy. They love having fun. They're quite attractive, too. Most of them have got dark hair and brown eyes.

The food is delicious. Brazilians love spicy food. I love eating the tasty seafood here and the coffee is great!

Tomorrow, I'm driving to Petrópolis to enjoy the mountain air. I'm also going to visit the cathedral and the Museum of the Empire. I'm leaving Rio next week, so I'll call you then.

You really must come here soon. Rio is such a colourful city! See you soon.

Love,
Mary

exercises.instructionEn: Read this sentence. What does it mean? - Honesty is the best policy.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gapni o'qing. U nimani anglatadi? - Halollik - eng yaxshi yo'l.
exercises.explanationUz:
'HONESTY IS THE BEST POLICY.'

  So'zma-so'z: Halollik - eng yaxshi
  siyosat.

  MA'NOSI: Har doim rost gapirish
  eng foydali yo'l - yolg'on oxir-oqibat
  ochiladi va ziyon keltiradi.


⚠ O'ZBEK MUQOBILLARI:

  'Rostgo'ylik - eng katta boylik.'
  'To'g'ri so'z - toshni yoradi.'


⚠ SO'ZLAR:

  honest (sifat) = halol
  honestY (ot) = halollik
  ⚠ 'h' O'QILMAYDI: 'onist'.

  a policy = siyosat, yo'l tutish
  ⚠ 'politics' (siyosat sohasi) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG.

  ⚠ 'the best' - 'good' sifatining
  eng yuqori darajasi:
     good → better → the best
  Bu - QOIDASIZ shakl.


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOL ShU YERDA:

  8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'honest' sifati
  bor edi: 'Tom is very honest. He never
  tells lies.'

  ⚠ Kitob so'zni MAQOL orqali
  mustahkamlaydi - maqol yaxshi esda
  qoladi, chunki u qisqa va ohangdor.


⚠ MAQOLDA ARTIKL YO'Q:

  'HonestY is the best policy.'
  ⚠ 'honesty' - MAVHUM ot, artiklsiz.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'Practice makes
  perfect', 'Time is money'.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Betdagi to'rt kasb - to'rt xil qo'shimcha.
'He's going bald' shu qoidadan: 'go' o'zgarish JARAYoNINI bildiradi.
Ikki so'z defis bilan birikib bitta sifat hosil qiladi. Matnda uchtasi bor.
Matnda 'Its tropical climate' va 'Its fascinating sights' - ikkalasi ham EGALIK.
'smoked salmon' va 'stunning view' - ikkalasi ham fe'ldan yasalgan sifat, lekin MA'NOSI TESKARI.

⚠ 'a historic day' (muhim kun) va 'a historical novel' (tarixiy roman) - FARQI BOR

sentencePatterns.formula: I think you should [fe'l]. I'm sure you would love it!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I think you should come here next year. I'm sure you would love it!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, kelasi yili bu yerga kelishing kerak. Ishonchim komil, senga juda yoqadi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Xatni TAVSIYA bilan yakunlash qolipi.
⚠ 'should' + oddiy fe'l ('to' siz).

sentencePatterns.formula: What does he/she do? - He's/She's a [kasb].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does she do? - She's a secretary.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning kasbi nima? - U kotib.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - DOIMIY kasb.
⚠ 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?

sentencePatterns.formula: What is he/she doing now? - He's/She's [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What is she doing now? - She's reading a magazine.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hozir nima qilyapti? - U jurnal o'qiyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS - HOZIRGI ish.
⚠ Oldingi qolip bilan SOLIShTIRING: bir xil fe'l
'do', ikki xil zamon, ikki xil ma'no.

sentencePatterns.formula: I usually [fe'l], but today I am [fe'l]-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I usually leave work at four, but today I'm staying late.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda ishdan to'rtda chiqaman, lekin bugun kech qolaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'usually' → SIMPLE; 'today' → CONTINUOUS.
⚠ Ikki zamonni bitta gapda qarshilantiruvchi
eng foydali qolip.

sentencePatterns.formula: How old are you? - I'm [son] years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How old are you? - I'm twelve years old.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Necha yoshdasiz? - Men o'n ikki yoshdaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Yosh 'to be' bilan aytiladi.
⚠ 'I have twelve years' - XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: What colour eyes have you got? - I've got [rang] eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colour eyes have you got? - I've got brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'zingiz qanday rangda? - Ko'zim jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'What colour' + OT + savol - turg'un qolip.
⚠ 'eyes' HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: This is [ism]. - Nice to meet you.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This is Carol. - Nice to meet you, Carol.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu Kerol. - Tanishganimdan xursandman, Kerol.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You must be Don Brown. Welcome to St Mary's!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Siz Don Braun bo'lsangiz kerak. St Mary'sga xush kelibsiz!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda TAXMIN bildiradi, majburiyat
emas.
⚠ 'Welcome TO [joy]' - predlog 'to'.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, ismingizni eshitolmadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Juda muloyim ibora - 'What?' dan ancha odobli.
⚠ 'to catch' bu yerda 'eshitib ulgurmoq'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Spain is a beautiful country in the south-west of Europe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ispaniya - Yevropaning janubi-g'arbidagi go'zal mamlakat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Maqolaning birinchi gapi.
⚠ 'in the south-west OF' - predlog 'of'.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Its warm weather and friendly people make it unique.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Iliq havosi va samimiy odamlari uni betakror qiladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Maqolaning oxirgi gapi - Tailand matnidagi
qolipning aynan o'zi.
⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ted is very friendly. He likes talking to other people.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ted juda samimiy. U boshqalar bilan gaplashishni yaxshi ko'radi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Xarakter: sifat + sabab gapi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Lisa is very young, with long straight dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Liza juda yosh, uzun tekis qora sochli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'with' + soch tavsifi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has got a fair complexion.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning yuz rangi oq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'has got' + soqol/ko'zoynak/ajinlar.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: David Duchovny is famous for playing Agent Mulder.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Devid Duxovni agent Malder rolini o'ynagani bilan mashhur.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'famous FOR' + V-ing.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What does he look like? - He's tall, with dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qanday ko'rinadi? - U baland bo'yli, qora sochli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Tashqi qiyofa savoli.

sentencePatterns.formula: Do you + FE'L ...? - Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Do you live near the city centre? - Yes, I do.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shahar markazi yaqinida yashaysanmi? - Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Present simple so'roq va qisqa javob.

sentencePatterns.formula: X usually + V-s, but X is + V-ing at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The sun usually shines, but it is raining at the moment.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Odatda quyosh porlaydi, lekin hozir yomg'ir yog'yapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Odatiy (simple) va hozirgi (continuous) qarama-qarshiligi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hello, Tracy. This is Tom.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom, Treysi. Bu Tom.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Telefonda 'This is', 'I am' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: X usually + V-s, but today X is + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Paul usually has a shave after breakfast, but today he is washing the car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pol odatda nonushtadan keyin soqol oladi, lekin bugun u mashina yuvyapti.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Odat (simple) va bugun (continuous).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Bill doesn't play tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bill tennis o'ynamaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Inkorda fe'lga -S qo'shilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Julio? How do you spell that? - J-U-L-I-O.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xulio? Buni qanday yoziladi? - J-U-L-I-O.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Ism harflab so'rash.

sentencePatterns.formula: I can't believe I'm here in [joy] on holiday!
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can't believe I'm here in Naples on holiday!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Neapolda ta'tilda ekanimga ishonolmayman!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Xat boshlanishi - hayrat.

sentencePatterns.formula: I spend most of my time + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I spend most of my time walking along the waterfront.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Vaqtimning ko'p qismini sohil bo'ylab sayr qilib o'tkazaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ 'spend time' + V-ing.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tomorrow, I'm taking the train to Pompeii.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga Pompeyga poyezdda boraman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Present continuous - aniq kelajak rejasi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You really should visit Naples soon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tez orada Neapolga albatta kelishing kerak.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Tavsiya xatboshisi.
